recognize_zh: 組織 Gram 染色中，一大塊紫紅色、邊緣模糊的絨毛狀／點狀陽性菌落團塊，位於黃褐色背景與發炎細胞之間；雖然個別絲狀菌解析不清，這種成團的 Gram 陽性絨毛狀物質對應放線菌硫磺顆粒。
features: Large irregular purple-magenta mass with fuzzy, finely granular/dot-like Gram-positive staining
Individual branching filaments are not well resolved; staining is patchy with a feathery edge
Yellow-brown counterstained background with red cells and fibrin surrounding the colony
Numerous inflammatory cells with red-stained nuclei (predominantly neutrophils) at the periphery
Clear slit-like spaces within the granule
describe_en: Tissue Gram stain of the peritoneal nodule shows a large irregular colony that stains purple-magenta with a fuzzy, finely granular and dot-like pattern of Gram positivity. Individual branching filaments are not clearly resolved, reflecting suboptimal staining quality. The colony is surrounded by yellow-brown counterstained red cells and fibrin and by an inflammatory infiltrate composed predominantly of neutrophils. In correlation with the H&E sulfur granule, findings are consistent with a colony of Gram-positive filamentous bacteria of actinomycosis.

ddx.vs: Nocardia also forms Gram-positive beaded branching filaments but is positive on modified acid-fast (Fite) stain, whereas Actinomyces is acid-fast negative.
Tissue Gram stain resolves discrete cocci or bacilli within the granule rather than a fuzzy filamentous mass.
Fungal grains contain broad septate hyphae that stain strongly with GMS/PAS and are not composed of thin Gram-positive filaments.
Precipitate is non-cellular and lies over background and cells alike, without a discrete colony bordered by neutrophils.
